name: Tabor V
description: Tabor V was a planet located in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Xyrass. The planet was controlled by a pirate organization known as the Snake's Guild. The Galactic Empire knew its coordinates, but the Imperial authority thought it was unoccupied.
lead_paragraphs: Tabor V was a planet located in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Xyrass. The planet was controlled by a pirate organization known as the Snake's Guild. The Galactic Empire knew its coordinates, but the Imperial authority thought it was unoccupied.
The only city on the planet was Karthren.
